item.title: Upbeat Earnings Bolster Case for India Stocks as Asia Wavers
item.description: Indian equities are gaining an edge in Asia as stronger earnings and a nascent return of foreign investors bolster the case for further outperformance.

item.title: DBS Profit Misses Estimates on Trading Income, Names Lim Chair
item.description: DBS Group Holdings Ltd. posted quarterly earnings that missed analyst estimates, as a tumble in markets trading income dampened gains from lending and wealth. The bank also announced a new chairman.

item.title: Election Night TV Viewers Rise With NBC in Lead, Fox Falling
item.description: Nearly 27.1 million people watched primetime news coverage of the 2026 midterm elections across the six largest TV networks, according to preliminary Nielsen data.

item.title: Host Hotels & Resorts CEO on 3Q Quarterly Results
item.description: Host Hotels & Resorts raised its full-year outlook, including adjusted EBITDA and comparable hotel RevPAR growth. CEO and President Jim Risoleo discussed the acquisition of 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge, the fourth 1e Hotel in Host’s portfolio. He cited its 2017 opening, lack of deferred capital expenditures, 175 rooms, meeting space, dining options and waterfront location overlooking Manhattan. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Sony Needs More Than ‘GTA’ and Spider-Man to Lift Stock Further
item.description: Investors are looking for reassurance on longer term earnings stability from Sony Group Corp. to help extend the nascent rebound in its shares.
